gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-m-plus-2: Contemporary in attitude, Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line with daylight inside every curve, while M PLUS 2 follows in a friendly sans with a wide c. Its marker-bold voice is the pair's best trait.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-m-plus-code-la: Red Hat Display writes in one marker-wide stroke, with light showing inside each curve. M PLUS Code Latin follows like bent neon tubing, its c opening like a pitcher's mouth, and the pair stays crisp throughout.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-m-plus-rounded: Approachable is the first word for M PLUS Rounded 1c, whose terminals stop short instead of curling back, a plain sans with a soft touch. And Red Hat Display does the loud work, holding its bold curves open with daylight inside.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-manjari: Red Hat Display lays down a marker-like line, bold and contemporary, with visible daylight inside every curve. And Manjari carries on in a plain sans of unvarying weight, its curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-meera-inimai: Bold marker strokes, then blueprint lettering. Red Hat Display keeps its curves open and loud, while Meera Inimai lets its own open-ended curves breathe, so the two feel like a shout followed by a sketch.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-metrophobic: Metrophobic sends each bend along a smooth, unobstructed path, modern and clean in a plain sans way. And Red Hat Display adds marker-weight boldness above, so a long read feels easy and unhurried.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-mina: Mina draws sans-serif strokes as plain as stitched thread outlines, with a generously unclosed curve on each small round letter. And Red Hat Display earns its place big and short, where its marker-like line can really speak.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-mingzat: Marker-bold up top, loose and curvy below. Red Hat Display stays monoline with daylight in every curve, and Mingzat, a plain sans that feels unclamped, lets a long passage move with an easy, relaxed flow.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-moderustic: Moderustic traces its curves with a broad nib and leaves them unfinished, giving the sans a modern, slightly rough hand. Red Hat Display answers with a gentle, marker-steady line.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-molengo: Molengo reads as a plain sans with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, contemporary and unfussy. Red Hat Display cuts like a laser sheet and handles bold headlines best.
